build-psu.title: Build a power supply
build-psu.prompt: Build a linear power supply from the AC mains to steady DC.

blocks.label: Transformer
blocks.does: steps the voltage down and isolates the output

blocks.label: Oscillator
blocks.does: makes a signal; no use in a power supply

slots.out: smooth DC with a little ripple

hints: Change the voltage first, while it's still AC.
build-psu.success: Transformer, rectifier, filter, regulator: AC steps down, becomes pulsating DC, is smoothed, then held steady.

find-heat.title: Which stage gets hot?
find-heat.prompt: Which stage typically needs a heat sink?

blocks.label: Transformer
blocks.does: gets warm, but is cooled by its own bulk

blocks.label: Rectifier
blocks.does: drops under a volt or so

blocks.label: Filter
blocks.does: is capacitors; they shouldn't get hot

blocks.label: Regulator
blocks.does: turns the extra voltage into heat

find-heat.success: The regulator. It drops the extra voltage at full current, and that becomes heat.
